name: gauntlet-loop
description: Codex edition of the gauntlet method: explicitly invoked mega-projects through approved plans, bounded agent workstreams, fresh critics, durable handoffs, and independent verification. The Claude Code and Cowork edition is the sibling gauntlet plugin.

interface.longDescription: A user-invoked Codex execution system for consequential software and knowledge-work projects. It turns an approved project constitution into bounded workstreams, separates builders from fresh critics, preserves state across sessions, integrates the whole project, and requires evidence-backed verification.
defaultPrompt: $gauntlet-loop:gauntlet Plan and run this as a Gauntlet project.
